observations: Standing gas cooker with 4 burners on top.
Oven door open, revealing empty interior with wire racks, seems clean inside.
Dark/stainless finish, control knobs visible for burners and oven.
Watermark overlay text on image reading something like 'ADDED ON TOP ... HOME APPLIANCES' - appears to be a seller/platform watermark, not a brand label on the appliance.
Background shows a cluttered storage/warehouse area with cartons and other items, suggesting a resale shop setting.
No manufacturer logo, model plate, or serial number visible on the unit itself.

identity.kind: standing gas cooker with oven and grill

claims.claim: Direct tokumbo (fairly used/imported) standing gas cooker
claims.evidence: No import documentation, country-of-origin marking, or proof of 'direct tokumbo' status visible in photo 0.
Photo 0 shows a reasonably clean exterior and oven interior, but surface cleanliness in one angle does not confirm overall condition (e.g., hidden rust, back panel, underside).
No photo or video shows flame ignition, oven heating, or grill function. A static photo cannot confirm operability.

risks.risk: Burners may not ignite or may have uneven flame.
risks.proof: Video clip of each burner being lit and showing flame.

risks.risk: Oven heating element may be faulty or absent.
risks.proof: Video showing oven interior glowing/heating with thermostat set.
Video/photo of grill element glowing when activated.
Photo/video of gas connection hose and regulator, plus leak-test demonstration.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working, with added risk discount

risks.risk: Hidden rust, dents, or missing knobs on unseen sides (back, underside).
risks.proof: Additional photos of rear, sides, and underside of the cooker.

risks.risk: No brand/model identifiable, affecting spare parts availability and resale value.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of any model plate or brand sticker, often found on the back or inside the oven door frame.

proof_requests: Video of all 4 burners being lit simultaneously.
Video of oven and grill heating up with visible glow/heat.
Close-up photo of any brand/model plate (usually on rear panel or inside oven door).
Photos of the back, sides, and underside of the unit for rust/damage check.
Photo of the gas hose/regulator connection point.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a standing gas cooker with oven and grill by type, but the seller's 'working perfectly' claim is unverified from a single static photo, so it must be priced at worst case (as not working) until a functional video is provided.
